text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said on Tuesday it initiated coverage of PhyCor Inc with an outperform rating, an intermediate-term target price of $39 in 1997 and a long-term target of $50 in 1998.
-- EVEREN called PhyCor one of the largest and fastest growing physician practice management companies in the nation, with 47 clinics in 26 states and more than 3,200 physician affiliates.
-- PhyCor should be able to achieve 33-percent annual revenue growth and 35-percent earnings growth over the next five years, EVEREN said.
-- PhyCor develops and manages independent practice associations.
-- Its shares were unchanged Tuesday at 30-1/2.
